walkthrough:
For Factory B, there are $n = 13$ data values. Let us write down the ordered list with their ranks:
1st: 0.031, 2nd: 0.035, 3rd: 0.038, 4th: 0.042, 5th: 0.044, 6th: 0.047, 7th: 0.048,
8th: 0.049, 9th: 0.051, 10th: 0.054, 11th: 0.056, 12th: 0.058, 13th: 0.064

Step 1: Locate the median.
The median is at position:
$$\text{Position} = \frac{n + 1}{2} = \frac{13 + 1}{2} = 7\text{th value}$$
The 7th value in the ordered list is $0.048\text{ g}$.
$$\text{Median} = 0.048\text{ g}$$

Step 2: Find the lower quartile $Q_1$.
The lower half consists of the first 6 values (values below the median): $0.031, 0.035, 0.038, 0.042, 0.044, 0.047$.
The midpoint of this lower half is between the 3rd and 4th values (position $3.5$):
$$Q_1 = \frac{0.038 + 0.042}{2} = 0.040\text{ g}$$

Step 3: Find the upper quartile $Q_3$.
The upper half consists of the last 6 values: $0.049, 0.051, 0.054, 0.056, 0.058, 0.064$.
The midpoint of this upper half is between the 10th and 11th values (position $10.5$):
$$Q_3 = \frac{0.054 + 0.056}{2} = 0.055\text{ g}$$

Step 4: Compute the interquartile range:
$$\mathrm{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 0.055 - 0.040 = 0.015\text{ g}$$
